reviewer: DeepSeek V4 Flash via OpenCode free

findings.issue: Common noun 'acequia' is kept in Latin script inside an otherwise Arabic sentence; it is not a genuine proper name or acronym and is inconsistent with the Arabic transliteration الأسيكيا used for the same term in this project's summary. Breaks Arabic mixed-script consistency.
findings.recommended_text: قنوات الأسيكيا الفردية وقطع أراضٍ وبنية تحتية مائية خاصة

findings.issue: 'township' translated as 'comunidade' narrows the meaning; Auroville is an international township (settlement), not merely a community. Rest of sentence accurate.
findings.recommended_text: Uma township internacional em Tamil Nadu que desde 1968 experimenta a vida comunitária, práticas ecológicas e organização social alternativa; a terra e os bens são legalmente detidos pela Auroville Foundation e não pertencem individualmente aos residentes.

findings.issue: 'e uma transferência solidária' can be misread as a parallel object of 'retirar'; mirrors the English source's ambiguity, a clearer connector would improve readability.
findings.recommended_text: Uma rede de projetos habitacionais auto-organizados que usa uma estrutura societária compartilhada para retirar imóveis permanentemente da revenda especulativa, além de uma transferência solidária para apoiar novos projetos habitacionais comunitários.

findings.issue: 'instituição hídrica' is a literal rendering of 'water institution' and is unidiomatic in Brazilian Portuguese; 'instituição de gestão da água' reads more naturally.
findings.recommended_text: Uma instituição de gestão da água formada por comunidades de aldeias na bacia do rio Arvari para organizar regras compartilhadas, responsabilidade e resolução de conflitos para a restauração e o uso do rio.

review_notes: es: all 88 projects verified semantically, numerically (17,000 / 1,006 / 2018 / 2010 / 2023 / 'más de 50'), terminologically and grammatically faithful; no untranslated prose beyond proper names; pass. fr: all 88 projects verified faithful with consistent terminology and correct numbers; pass. pt-BR: all 88 projects faithful and idiomatic with correct pt-BR number formats; three non-blocking fluency/style observations recorded as notes, no severity defects; pass. ar: 88 projects faithful, numbers intact, correct MSA, Arabic mixed-script quality good except one Latin-script common noun ('acequia') inconsistent with its transliteration in the same project; one minor defect -> needs_fixes. Aggregate verdict driven by the ar minor finding.
